headlines.headline: MICHIGAN'S TITLE RUN LEAVES BEHIND A COACHING VACANCY
headlines.detail: Dusty May left for the NBA and AD Warde Manuel will step down by year's end. Jeremy Fears Jr. is drawing preseason buzz as a threat to the career assists record.

headlines.headline: RUSSELL WESTBROOK RETIRES AFTER 18 SEASONS AND NINE ALL-STAR NODS
headlines.detail: Westbrook retired Aug. 12. Bradley Beal signed a two-year deal with the Clippers, and Cleveland/Charlotte swapped guards, sending Dennis Schröder to the Hornets for Tre Mann.

headlines.headline: VON MILLER SIGNS WITH COWBOYS, CHASING A THIRD SUPER BOWL RING
headlines.detail: Miller, 37, joined Dallas. Texans WR Jayden Higgins is out for the season with a torn ACL; Ja'Marr Chase and Derrick Henry dropped out of the NFL Top 100's top 10.

headlines.headline: OHIO STATE OPENS FALL CAMP AS THE TITLE FAVORITE
headlines.detail: QB Julian Sayin and WR Jeremiah Smith return under new OC Arthur Smith. Defending champ Indiana and a coaching carousel (Kiffin to LSU, Franklin to Virginia Tech) reshape the race.
